title: Genghis Khan's tomb has been missing for 800 years
hook: THE WORLD'S GREATEST TOMB IS LOST
voiceover: Genghis Khan died in 1227. He conquered more land than any human in history. He had more descendants than maybe any human in history — around 1 in 200 men alive today share his Y chromosome. And then he disappeared. According to legend, his soldiers buried him in a secret location somewhere in Mongolia. They killed every person who saw the funeral procession to keep the location hidden. They diverted a river over the burial site. They rode horses across the grave to flatten it. They did everything possible to make sure no one would ever find him. And so far, no one has. Treasure hunters have spent fortunes searching. Modern Mongolians refuse to dig — they consider it sacred. The man who ruled half the world is still hidden, somewhere in the mountains he came from. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
